# Igris 2.1.1 - Windows screenshot hotfix

- Screenshot/image coding questions no longer attach automatic MCP tools. Vision models can answer directly without requiring tool calling or MCP support.
- Stale music-model profiles are skipped, and duplicate resolved vision routes are tried once per provider/model/region.
- Explicit browsing retains its existing consent and capability gates; ordinary text MCP requests are preserved.

Verified with overlay regression tests, native tests and live Groq analysis of a synthetic screen with background MCP configured. This is a Windows hotfix; Android remains 2.1.0 and production signing stays deferred until after V2.3.
